# Exploring the Synergy of Quantitative Factors and Newsflow Representations from Large Language Models for Stock Return Prediction

| **task** | Predicting stock returns from multimodal quantitative factors and LLM-generated newsflow representations, used for stock selection into long-only and long-short portfolios. | “This paper examines effective methods for leveraging multimodal factors and newsflow in return prediction and stock selection.” |
| **architecture** | News headlines encoded by an LLM into a newsflow vector; fused with ~200 factors via combination, summation or attention; a mixture model weights a factor-based dense network and a fusion component, trained with decoupled training (independent squared-error terms plus KL distribution matching). | “First, we introduce a fusion learning framework to learn a unified representation from factors and newsflow representations generated by an LLM. Within this framework, we compare three methods of different architectural complexities: representation combination, representation summation, and attentive representations.” |
| **data** | North American, Emerging Markets and European universes (up to ~1,000 stocks each; 830/1090/370 stocks), ~200 quantitative factors, company-level news headlines from a commercial vendor; one-month forward return target, monthly rebalancing. | “We have three datasets corresponding to the North American (NA), Emerging Markets (EM), and European (EU) investment universes, each containing up to \sim 1,000 stocks. We use company-level financial news data provided by a commercial data vendor.” |
| **window** | Training and validation 2003 to 2022; testing 2023 to 2024, evaluated without retraining. | “The training and validation data span from 2003 to 2022, and the testing data cover the two-year period from 2023 to 2024.” |
| **models** | Encoder-only DeBERTa as the LLM for all methods, optionally fine-tuned with LoRA (rank 4) on all linear layers; dense neural networks for prediction components. | “For a fair comparison, we employ the encoder-only LLM, DeBERTa [31], across our fusion learning methods, mixture models, and all LLM-based baselines.” |
| **baselines** | Equal-weighted Universe portfolio, Factors Alone dense network, News Alone (LLM representation plus prediction layer), and FININ; also compared across internal fusion variants and conventional-trained mixture. | “Universe refers to a portfolio that equally weights all stocks in the investment universe.
